url.ask: OPC UA endpoint of iControl's OPC server on the bench PC
url.help: Shown in the iControl OPC server's configuration (or in UaExpert once you connect). The port is not published by Mettler; 4840 is the OPC UA default and a placeholder.

username.ask: OPC UA user name, if the server requires one (Enter for anonymous)

nodes.ask: Node ids (edit config.json after browsing the server; see references/opcua_nodes.md)
